facts.text: Mary, I ordered the most expensive thing on the menu. It's a burger. We're splitting it.
facts.why: Lloyd never says this. It is printed in quote marks and signed Lloyd Christmas, so it reads as a film quote, but no such line is in the film.
facts.fix: So you're telling me there's a chance. Yeah!

fix_note.text: So you're telling me there's a chance. Yeah!

facts.why: It is a briefcase, not a suitcase, and Mary did not lose it. She leaves it at the airport on purpose as the ransom drop for her kidnapped husband.
facts.fix: Mary Swanson's briefcase, left at the airport

vibe.verdict: Fun idea to run the Mutt Cutts van as a food truck, but the board reads like any diner and skips most of the lines fans quote.
missing: The most annoying sound in the world (Lloyd in the van with Mental)
Turbo Lax in Harry's coffee (Lloyd's revenge in Aspen)
Sea Bass stuck with the diner bill (truck stop diner)
Tongue frozen to the ski lift pole (Harry on the chairlift)
The trooper drinking the beer bottle of pee (roadside stop)
Trading the van for a minibike (Lloyd's deal on the road)
ideas: Swap the made up Lloyd note for a line he says, such as 'So you're telling me there's a chance.'
Swap 'Ski lodge hot chocolate' for 'Lloyd's special coffee, no Turbo Lax'
Swap 'Truck stop onion rings' for 'Onion rings, Sea Bass is paying'
Swap 'Aspen snowflake cookies' for 'Frozen snot icicle meringues' from the minibike ride into Aspen
